changelog_text:
Kitten Intelligent Trajectory Navigator for Kitten Space Agency.

Download **KITN-0.1.3.zip**. Extract its KITN folder into your KSA profile's mods folder, enable KITN in manifest.toml, and launch with StarMap 0.5.4 or newer. The archive uses Borea's standard mod layout.

Version: **0.1.3**. Commit: 8fcf50a15b204cf8d47994951cc94a8bb10e1578.

Source code: https://github.com/steve-787/KITN/tree/v0.1.3

The .sha256 file contains the archive's SHA-256 checksum.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/steve-787/KITN/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3

listing.name: KITN
listing.abstract: Automatic ascent, transfer planning, rendezvous, docking and landing for Kitten Space Agency.
listing.description:
Kitten Intelligent Trajectory Navigator. Pick a target orbit and start KITN to automate your flight.

- Ascent guidance, gravity turns and staging.
- Transfer planning and maneuver execution.
- Automated rendezvous and docking.
- Return-to-pad landing.
- Flight instruments and remote vessel control.

Updated regularly and still in development. Absolutely not stable right now. Save your game before flying.
